prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Storybook Visual Path Carousel: Redesign the path selection screen into a visual carousel format with animated path cards. (why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and drop-off rate of ~24%, indicating users need clearer, more engaging visually distinguished path choices.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Tray Control Tutorial: Add an explicit post-onboarding tutorial screen showing how to summon, minimize, and talk to the pet from the system tray. (why: The finish step takes a mean of 5815s with 35% drop-off, and support received multiple tickets from users who could not figure out how to hide or talk to their pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] Taskbar Diagnostic Waiting Indicator: Show an active status timer and taskbar tray loading status while the app renders the pet on the desktop. (why: The waiting screen has a mean duration of 2336s and support reported 3 cases where the pet failed to render or the app stalled on startup.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Fast-Track Onboarding Path Explanation: Clarify in the body copy that choosing a path is fast and reversible later from settings. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating hesitation due to fear of making a permanent choice.)
4: [finish, notification] Pet Desktop Shortcut Toggle Notification: Display a notification tip banner highlighting hotkey shortcuts for showing and hiding the pet. (why: Support received multiple complaints from users who could not figure out how to hide or interact with the pet once finished.)

scores.note: Visual redesign of choose_path addresses long mean time, but high median disparity suggests outliers rather than universal failure; UI overhaul carries moderate risk and high dev cost.
Finish step has a large drop-off (35%) and long mean delay, strongly backed by support tickets. Adding a full new screen is costly but directly addresses high drop-off.
Home step has moderate drop-off; diagnostic timer directly addresses support tickets regarding app stalling/rendering delays with low implementation overhead.
Simple copy change reassuring users about reversibility effectively targets decision hesitation at minimal cost.
Targets the major bottleneck at finish step where drop-off is high and support tickets are explicit, using a simple notification tip banner.
